Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryCatalyticReformingFeedBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryCatalyticReformingFeedBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryCatalyticReformingFeedBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable aggregate receipt for a multi-cut catalytic-reforming feed screen.

Each cut delegates to RefineryCatalyticReformingStoichiometricBalance. The aggregate therefore preserves the same-carbon-number naphthene dehydrogenation and paraffin dehydrocyclization boundary while exposing feed, reformate, aromatic, hydrogen, and closure totals for a carbon-number distribution.

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public static RefineryCatalyticReformingFeedBalance calculate(int[] carbonNumbers, double[] naphtheneFeedFlowsKmolPerHour, double[] paraffinFeedFlowsKmolPerHour, double[] naphtheneConversionFractions, double[] paraffinConversionFractions)
      Calculate a multi-cut catalytic-reforming stoichiometric receipt.

      Arrays share one index and are retained in caller order. Carbon numbers must be unique and at least six. Every row must contain a positive naphthene-plus-paraffin flow. Conversion values are caller-owned scenario assumptions, not yield predictions.

      Parameters:
      carbonNumbers - carbon number for each feed cut
      naphtheneFeedFlowsKmolPerHour - naphthene feed flows in kmol/h
      paraffinFeedFlowsKmolPerHour - paraffin feed flows in kmol/h
      naphtheneConversionFractions - naphthene conversion fractions in [0, 1]
      paraffinConversionFractions - paraffin conversion fractions in [0, 1]
      Returns:
      immutable multi-cut material-balance receipt
